prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A cute chubby cartoon mascot cat, drawn as an exaggerated laughing reaction sticker: a plump pear-shaped body with an oversized round head, very short stubby arms and legs, tiny rounded triangular ears, soft creamy milk-yellow fur with a slightly paler belly and muzzle, three thin black whiskers on each cheek, and a short fat tail. Its head is thrown back and tilted slightly to one side in a fit of hysterical laughter: the eyes are squeezed completely shut into thick upward-curving black crescent arcs, with two tiny cartoon teardrops squeezing out at the outer corners; the mouth is enormous, gaping wide open in a huge upward-curving grin that takes up most of the lower half of the face, a dark maroon interior with a big rounded pink tongue and two tiny white fangs at the top; round hot-pink blush circles on both cheeks; one stubby paw flung up in the air, the other pressed against its belly. Small black comic emphasis lines and a couple of tiny sparkle marks radiate from the head to signal loud, uncontrollable laughter.
